Productcatalogservice is identified as the initiator by IVD with Copeland score 3, exhibiting strong internal mechanism (cpu, memory, socket) near onset (1705340544). Its anomaly explains downstream symptoms: recommendationservice shows 20 symptom-to-candidate paths, confirming its latency is caused by productcatalogservice as a callee; redis disk/memory/cpu spikes are reactive to productcatalogservice load without emitter exceptions. Recommendationservice's earlier onset is not independent—it depends on productcatalogservice. Other candidates are IVD victims (currencyservice, etc.) or ambiguous with weak internal signals. No log errors are observed, but multi-signal mechanism and IVD ranking provide decisive source evidence. The fault propagates to recommendationservice and frontend, with storage dependency effects.
uncertainties: No log errors or stack traces to confirm the exact application-level fault, but mechanism and IVD evidence are sufficient.

final_decision.mechanism: Internal gRPC InactiveRpcError exceptions causing latency degradation and cascading failures to downstream services (productcatalogservice, frontend).
final_decision.rationale: Recommendationservice is the IVD initiator with own-code stack trace and emitter exceptions (gRPC errors) near onset (1705519124). It directly calls productcatalogservice (20 request paths), explaining its reactive 'context deadline exceeded' errors. Frontend errors ('failed to get product recommendations') link to recommendationservice failures. Counterfactual evidence shows recommendationservice explains downstream anomalies. Other candidates (redis, productcatalogservice, frontend) are either ambiguous/victims or lack internal fault signatures. Redis disk spike is late and reactive. So root cause is recommendationservice.
